newsitem.title: USA: Kent sees favorable Q2/year-ago comparison.
newsitem.headline: Kent sees favorable Q2/year-ago comparison.

text.p: Kent Electronics Corp said Thursday it expects to report favorable year-over-year comparisons in its fiscal second quarter as the company reaps the benefit of the growth initiatives and investments made in fiscal 1997.

The company made the prediction as it reported first quarter 1998 net earnings of $8.8 million or $0.32 per share on net sales of $125.1 million. That compared with net earnings of $9.4 million, or $.34 per share on net sales of $125.1 million for last year's first quarter, it said.
Morrie Abramson, chairman and chief executive officer said the company's fiscal 1988 "is off to a good start," reflecting the improving business conditions in its markets.
For its second quarter ended September 28, 1996, the company reported net earnings of $6.4 million or $0.25 per share on net sales of $102.4 million.
